description: The documented virtualMap sources of the export plan (src/export/virtual_maps.h, decision 086): the operators reproduced exactly through the plan (evaluated by EvaluateFileOn and written with each file's write rule) and the documented maps without a golden yet.

entries.subject: Normal_OpenGL: the mesh normal, the Normal channel and the normal derived from Height combined, encoded for the OpenGL convention (green up)
entries.formula: n = normalise(reoriented(normalise(reoriented(flat, H)), decode(C))) with H the height-derived normal of the texture set's method and C the Normal channel composited over (0.5, 0.5, 1); Normal_OpenGL = fma(n, 1/2, 1/2), written with the file's write rule (parity/semantics/height-to-normal.json, decisions 064 and 065).

entries.subject: AO_Mixed: the baked ambient occlusion mesh map mixed with the AO channel
entries.formula: a' = (1 + a) - 1 with a the AO mesh map operand; c = fma(S, al, 1) - al, the AO fill mixed over the white base (S the source, written as an L16 code first on an L16 channel; al the layer opacity, its L16 code with ties down on an L16 channel, float32 on L32F), or 1 without a layer; v = a' c; AO_Mixed = WriteUnorm((v - 1) + 1, 8) / 255, every step one float32 rounding (decision 411).

entries.notes: Fitted exactly (decision 411; tools/parity/fit/ao_mixed_scan.py, recordings R-086a, R-092, R-131 with its stability controls, and the operand probe ao-mixed-operand-probe): every r1 AO_Mixed export of the 13 admitted AO goldens, PNG 8, PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f, 0 differing. The stored channel is not the operand: an L16 channel stores the mix quantized and an L32F one fma(S - 1, al, 1). Fills of one source compose to one mix of opacity 1 - prod(1 - opacity) (a group multiplies its children's opacity); the plan computes only no AO layer or one root fill in Normal (grey uniform colour or 8- or 16-bit grey bitmap at 1:1 under the identity UV projection), on an L16 or L32F channel, with an 8- or 16-bit grey AO mesh map at the set's resolution, under legacy colour management, the default template and full UV coverage, and refuses every other configuration before writing. Decision 418 widens it to any UV coverage (covered texels exact on R-314's islanded goldens, the uncovered ones padded under EXC-013), no AO channel (c = 1, ao-mixed-islands-ocio) and OCIO with Painter's substance config for no AO channel, no AO layer or one 16-bit grey bitmap fill on L16 at opacity 1. After save and reopen (r2) Painter's AO_Mixed differs from r1 on blended sets, deterministically (r2 = r3 = r4); r1 is the target (decision 032).

entries.notes: Operator: enc(L (1 - m)), RGB. Fitted exactly (decision 092): r1 = r2 on every texel of s0-s7 at PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f, 0 differing values in each of the 16 comparisons. Inputs: L the BaseColor channel's linear sRGB8 operand, r and m the SpecularRoughness and BaseMetalness values, float32; enc is Painter 12.1.5's sRGB encode x <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 x : fma(1.055, exp2(0.41666 log2 x), -0.055) with the recording GPU's exp2 and log2; toL(v) = fma(0.114, v, fma(0.299, v, 0.587 v)). Where a channel has no layer the map reads L = 1.3, r = 0.5980393 (0x3F19191A) and m = 0, not the channel's base value. Still a release gap: the plan needs each channel's per-texel coverage (the evaluator gives none), and the uncovered constants were seen on one template only (recording R-092).

It varies texel to texel without period where roughness is above 0, and differs between sets with identical inputs (s5 and s6 at 3 texels).
